title: You find a room filled with strange metal cylinders.
text: You find a room filled with strange metal cylinders. Inside of each cylinder is a living brain that can communicate through a speaker box. You ask them for help (Influence).

pass.text: They describe how to operate the mi-go's machinery to travel between worlds. Based on what they say, you try to operate the alien devices (Lore). If you pass, you return home; close this Gate. If you fail, the machine shows you horrid vistas you would never want to visit; lose 1 Sanity.
you return home; close this Gate.

fail.text: the machine shows you horrid vistas you would never want to visit; lose 1 Sanity.
The disembodied brains demand that you stay. They tell you terrible secrets they've learned about the fate of the Earth. Lose 2 Sanity unless you spend 1 Clue.

title: You discover a waxen mask and artificial hands.
text: You discover a waxen mask and artificial hands. Your mind reels as you realize that the old man you had spoken to earlier was actually some terrible creature disguised as a human (Will).

pass.text: You realize now that the old man's words carry a secondary meaning. You attempt to decrypt what he said (Lore). If you pass, you understand the man's implied instructions; close this Gate. If you fail, his words lead you in circles; become Delayed.
you understand the man's implied instructions; close this Gate.

fail.text: his words lead you in circles; become Delayed.

What was the nature of that blasphemous horror behind the mask? You consult your notes, trying to find what might disguise itself this way (Lore-1). If you pass, you find the data you need; close this Gate. If you fail, fear of the unknowable eats at your thoughts; lose 3 Sanity.

pass.text: you find the data you need; close this Gate.

fail.text: fear of the unknowable eats at your thoughts; lose 3 Sanity.

title: You discover a fetid creature with wings and webbed feet.
text: You discover a fetid creature with wings and webbed feet. The beast is strange, like something from your wildest dreams. You may spend 1 Clue to resolve the pass effect. If you do not spend the Clue, resolve the fail effect.

pass.text: you remember that by drinking space-mead you can safely use this byakhee to return home; close this Gate.

fail.text: you drink something you shouldn't have; gain a Hallucinations Condition.

pass.text: you subdue the creature and use it to return home; close this Gate.

title: The mi-go refuse to go near the city of green pyramids.
text: The mi-go refuse to go near the city of green pyramids. You summon your courage and explore this abandoned area (Will).

pass.text: You find lost treasure! Gain 1 Artifact. You hear sounds coming from within the pyramids and look for a place to hide (Observation-1). If you pass, you stay out of sight until the threat is gone; close this Gate. If you fail, you wake up uncertain of what's happened; gain an Amnesia Condition.
you stay out of sight until the threat is gone; close this Gate.

fail.text: you wake up uncertain of what's happened; gain an Amnesia Condition.

You run from the pyramids as fast as you can. Until the mi-go return, you need to rely on your own means of survival (Strength). If you fail, you succumb to the harsh elements of this strange world; lose 1 Health and 1 Sanity.
you succumb to the harsh elements of this strange world; lose 1 Health and 1 Sanity.
